<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description/><name>ER Triage - Setup Groups and Demo Users</name><record_for_rollback>true</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[(function() {
  var SCOPE = 'x_2206627_er_tri_0';

  var USERS = [
    { user_name: 'iris.intake',     first: 'Iris', last: 'Intake' },
    { user_name: 'nina.nurse',      first: 'Nina', last: 'Nurse' },
    { user_name: 'carl.charge',     first: 'Carl', last: 'Charge' },
    { user_name: 'paul.provider',   first: 'Paul', last: 'Provider' },
    { user_name: 'greg.governance', first: 'Greg', last: 'Governance' },
    { user_name: 'alex.appadmin',   first: 'Alex', last: 'AppAdmin' }
  ];

  var GROUPS = [
    { name: 'ER Registration',       role: 'intake',              manager: 'carl.charge',     members: ['iris.intake'] },
    { name: 'ER Triage Nurses',      role: 'triage_nurse',        manager: 'carl.charge',     members: ['nina.nurse'] },
    { name: 'ER Charge Nurses',      role: 'charge_nurse',        manager: 'carl.charge',     members: ['carl.charge'] },
    { name: 'ER Providers',          role: 'provider',            manager: 'paul.provider',   members: ['paul.provider'] },
    { name: 'ER Clinical Governance', role: 'clinical_governance', manager: 'greg.governance', members: ['greg.governance'] },
    { name: 'ER Triage App Admins',  role: 'admin',               manager: 'alex.appadmin',   members: ['alex.appadmin'] }
  ];

  var userIds = {};

  // 1. Users (no passwords: use impersonation for the demo)
  USERS.forEach(function(u) {
    var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
    if (!gr.get('user_name', u.user_name)) {
      gr.initialize();
      gr.setValue('user_name', u.user_name);
      gr.setValue('first_name', u.first);
      gr.setValue('last_name', u.last);
      gr.setValue('email', u.user_name + '@example.com');
      gr.setValue('active', true);
      gr.insert();
      gs.info('Created user ' + u.user_name);
    }
    userIds[u.user_name] = gr.getUniqueValue();
  });

  // 2. Groups, group roles, and memberships
  GROUPS.forEach(function(g) {
    var grp = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
    if (!grp.get('name', g.name)) {
      grp.initialize();
      grp.setValue('name', g.name);
      grp.setValue('description', 'ER Triage Assistant demo group (synthetic)');
      grp.setValue('manager', userIds[g.manager]);
      grp.setValue('active', true);
      grp.insert();
      gs.info('Created group ' + g.name);
    }
    var groupId = grp.getUniqueValue();

    var role = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role');
    if (!role.get('name', SCOPE + '.' + g.role)) {
      gs.warn('Role not found: ' + SCOPE + '.' + g.role + ' (skipped for ' + g.name + ')');
    } else {
      var gr2 = new GlideRecord('sys_group_has_role');
      gr2.addQuery('group', groupId);
      gr2.addQuery('role', role.getUniqueValue());
      gr2.query();
      if (!gr2.next()) {
        gr2.initialize();
        gr2.setValue('group', groupId);
        gr2.setValue('role', role.getUniqueValue());
        gr2.insert();
        gs.info('Assigned ' + g.role + ' to ' + g.name);
      }
    }

    g.members.forEach(function(m) {
      var mem = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
      mem.addQuery('group', groupId);
      mem.addQuery('user', userIds[m]);
      mem.query();
      if (!mem.next()) {
        mem.initialize();
        mem.setValue('group', groupId);
        mem.setValue('user', userIds[m]);
        mem.insert();
        gs.info('Added ' + m + ' to ' + g.name);
      }
    });
  });

  gs.info('ER Triage setup complete');
})();]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-23 19:54:14</sys_created_on><sys_id>7f1c572ec3c0d31043d2ffbc0501315f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ER Triage - Setup Groups and Demo Users</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ER Triage Assistant" source="x_2206627_er_tri_0">2d92da56c34c131043d2ffbc05013153</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ER Triage Assistant">2d92da56c34c131043d2ffbc05013153</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_7f1c572ec3c0d31043d2ffbc0501315f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-23 19:54:14</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>
